attributes.help: The accordion uses collapse internally to make it collapsible. To render an accordion that’s expanded, add the .open class on the .accordion.

attributes.label: Always Open
attributes.help: Omit the data-bs-parent attribute on each .accordion-collapse to make accordion items stay open when another item is opened.
